- SDR: new Meshtastic receiver (868 or 433 MHz, every European preset): nodes, map, messages and telemetry on the default channels and on channels you add with their key
- SDR: new MeshCore receiver (869.618 MHz): signed node adverts, map, the Public channel and the #hashtag channels you add, the route of each packet
- SDR: new LoRa APRS receiver (433.775 and 434.855 MHz), with the map of stations
- SDR: new 406 MHz distress beacon receiver (EPIRB, ELT, PLB): identity, country, protocol, position, self-tests marked
- SDR: new Z-Wave receiver (868.40, 868.42 and 869.85 MHz): networks, nodes and commands in the clear
- SDR: new SSTV receiver (the ISS on 145.800 MHz, or any frequency): Robot, Martin, Scottie, PD and Wraase pictures, saved as PNG
- SDR: new Zigbee / 802.15.4 receiver at 2.4 GHz (one channel or all of them in turn) and new ANT+ receiver for sports sensors (heart rate, bike power, cadence, speed)
- Wi-Fi: LAN devices, coverage map, network audit, fake access points and man-in-the-middle are greyed out when the phone is not on Wi-Fi
- Settings: a debug log (at most 50 MB) to share, save or clear, for reporting a bug
